conflicts.fact: How many times more resistive silicon is than copper
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4's Predict phase says silicon is 'about 10^11 times more resistive than copper', which agrees with the fact sheet (about 1.4 x 10^11). Lesson 2 gives the figure as 1.4 x 10^11, so this is only a rounding difference and not a real conflict.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson's class model Lesson 5 starts from
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 revises the Lesson 3 model. Lesson 5's Predict phase uses the 'one-page class model from Lesson 4', which fits the sequence, so this is not a real conflict.
